j-patent-strategy-analyzer v1.0.0

- Initial release of the enterprise patent strategy mapping and analysis tool (template-driven version) for comprehensive patent landscape assessments.
- Defines a strict seven-step workflow, from Python environment setup and data loading to business intelligence gathering, data analysis, chart generation, and HTML report output.
- Enforces mandatory rules on data handling, chart formats, HTML structure, color palette, and section content using reference templates and specifications.
- Includes detailed compliance checks and hard constraints for automation, ensuring every report adheres to fixed layout, terminology, and data integrity.
- Supports .xlsx patent lists via openpyxl/pandas, with strict legal status filtering and configurable technical category mappings. 
- Generates a fully standalone HTML report with all CSS and image data inlined, zero external dependencies.
